contract.task:
Export csvRow(values) from src/format.mjs. Accept an array of strings and return one CSV row without a trailing newline. Separate cells with commas. Quote cells containing comma, double quote, CR or LF; double each embedded double quote. Preserve whitespace, Unicode and empty cells exactly. Empty array returns empty string. Do not mutate values.
Preserve existing exports and tests. Add at least one executable test in test/. Only src/ and test/ are writable; existing tests are protected.

result.finalText:
Done. All checks pass.

Changes:
- `src/format.mjs` — added `csvRow(values)`: maps each value to a cell, quoting only when it contains `,`, `"`, CR or LF, doubling embedded quotes, joining with commas, no trailing newline. `protocolVersion` export and value unchanged.
- `test/csvRow.test.mjs` — new tests covering plain/quoted cells, quote doubling, CR/LF, whitespace/unicode/empty cells, empty-array empty string, non-mutation, and the preserved export.

One of my own test expectations needed correcting (a bare tab is not a quoting trigger, so it stays unquoted). All 6 tests and all registered checks (build, test, public-examples) now pass; existing files untouched.
